channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Shipworks+
item.description: Design and build your own walkable ship, mast by mast and sail by sail, then sail it by the wind.

item.title: Riichi Mahjong
item.description: Pass time by playing riichi mahjong with friends or against bots! Rules are handled automatically.

item.title: Neolithic Hammer
item.description: A stone hammer to help you progress to the copper age more quickly

item.description: The sea gets weather: storms, surf, currents. And six new vessels that wear, swamp and break.

item.description: - Using One Hand as a dependancy, creates three inventory bar slots with one backpack slot open.

item.description: Plants make the real vanilla fat, wax and bone meal, so every recipe that wants them just works.

item.title: Wilderlands Onus Capacitatis
item.description: - Adds a volume feature to the game's storage mechanics.

item.title: Practical Electricity

item.title: Raider Camps
item.description: Adds small raider camps to the world!

item.description: Gamefied Economy revises trader tables to enhance profit and progression.

item.description: Some fun admin commands.
